description: Comptage routier - Base routière métropole (2020) is a dataset listed in DATA Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Métropole Aix-Marseille Provence. Cartographie de Bruit Stratégique La base routière modélisée est une donnée collectée dans le cadre du projet du diagnostic du bruit (routier, industriel, aérien). Ce projet a été initié et géré par la DGA Stratégie Environnementale. La base modélisée sert de support pour évaluer le bruit routier. Coverage: Aix-Marseille-Provence Metropolis. The portal files it under Transports. Its keywords are trafic, circulation, tmja, bruit. The portal shows 163,998 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-01 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte 2.0 (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/ETALAB-Licence-Ouverte-v2.0.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-ampmetropole-fr-portal.
